title: What is Claude, and what are Projects and Artifacts?
description: Claude has four parts and most people only ever use one. A plain map of the window: Projects, the chat, the input, and Artifacts.

faq.a: A folder that remembers. You load it once with knowledge files — the documents it should always have read — plus standing instructions on how to behave. Every chat started inside that project already knows all of it, so there is no re-briefing and no re-uploading.

Output that is a document rather than a message. When the result is a real thing — a doc, a page, a table — it opens in a panel beside the chat and updates in place as you ask for changes, keeping every version so you can go back.
